notes: 1.51.1: KNL 'Đề xuất nâng bậc' — batch 2.1 TECHNICAL HARDENING per Technical Lead review of 1.51.0. Code + local tests only, migration still NOT applied to Production, no Production data written, no push/deploy, no UI polish. (1) ATOMIC WRITES (P0): the 2-step non-atomic proposal-update+step-insert from 1.51.0 is replaced with 2 Postgres RPCs added to the SAME (still-unapplied) scripts/PHF_KNL_GRADE_PROMOTION_PROPOSAL_1.51.0.sql — knl_grade_promotion_propose() (create: proposal row + all initial steps, incl. auto-agree collapse, in one transaction) and knl_grade_promotion_transition() (agree/approve/reject/withdraw, incl. any reassign audit step, in one transaction; also adds an optimistic-concurrency guard via SELECT...FOR UPDATE + expected-status/expected-step-index, translated to 409 KNL_PROPOSAL_STATE_CHANGED on conflict — a correctness improvement beyond the original create-only DB guard). Business logic (routing/authorization/grade bounds) stays entirely in Node; RPCs only perform the atomic write. (2) TITLE AUTHORIZATION FALLBACK REMOVED (P0): subjectIsApproverRole() in lib/knl-grade-proposals.js no longer reads title at all — purely capabilities.agree_proposal on an active grant. Sales creation flow fails closed with a distinct KNL_PROPOSAL_SALES_NOT_CONFIGURED (409) when zero accounts hold agree_proposal+sales_all_branches, and a new self-select guard (KNL_PROPOSAL_SALES_APPROVER_SELF_NOT_ALLOWED) blocks picking yourself as your own approver. No employee_code is hard-coded anywhere in the authorization path. (3) PERMISSION INITIALIZATION PLAN: new scripts/phf-knl-grade-promotion-permission-init-plan.js, dry-run by default (never run with --apply this batch) — computed the exact per-account capability/proposalScope diff against live Prod knl_permission_grants (37 active accounts) needed to make the workflow operational per the confirmed policy matrix; zero writes performed, reviewable output captured in the batch report. (4) CREATION-SCOPE SEMANTIC ASSESSMENT: evidence-based conclusion (documented at lib/knl-grade-proposals.js#creationAuthorized) that reusing people_scope for proposal creation/processing is semantically correct given the batch's own 'phạm vi phụ trách' wording matches people_scope's original definition and every existing grant already shares one scope across view_people+agree_proposal — no proposalCreateScope introduced (no unproven data-model change). (5) Trial-period-elapsed warning residual unchanged, per instruction to keep it deferred rather than guess employee_profiles.hire_date's exact semantics.
